# iosxr_segment_routing_mapping_server (Data Source)

This data source can read the Segment Routing Mapping Server configuration.

## Version Compatibility

### Removed from version

| Attribute | Version |
|-----------|:-------:|
| `mapping_prefix_sid_address_family.prefix_addresses` | `25.4` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxr_segment_routing_mapping_server" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `mapping_prefix_sid_address_family` (Attributes List) Address Family (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mapping_prefix_sid_address_family))
